content.title: How to watch Rangers vs. Mariners: TV channel and streaming options for April 18
content.text: The Seattle Mariners hope to end their four-game losing run against the Texas Rangers, on Saturday at 7:15 p.m. ET. George Kirby (2-2, 3.25 ERA) will start for the Mariners, who are 8-13 this season and fifth in the AL West. Nathan Eovaldi (2-2, 5.40 ERA) is starting for the Rangers, who are 11-9 and first in the AL West.How to watch Texas Rangers vs. Seattle Mariners Venue: T-Mobile Park Time: 7:15 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: FOX Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has a 15.7% strikeout rate and a 13.5% walk rate in 89 plate appearances, and he has scored 16 total runs. Arozarena has recorded five steals on five attempts. In 71 plate appearances, Brendan Donovan is hitting .304/.437/.518 with a .954 OPS and one steal on two attempts. He has hit three long balls, driven in eight runs and scored seven times. Brandon Nimmo is hitting for a .313 BA, .396 OBP and .538 SLG with a 20.9% strikeout rate and a 9.9% walk rate. His OPS is .933, which ranks 18th in MLB, and he has scored 13 runs. In 91 plate appearances, he has hit four home runs and driven in 11 runs. In 83 plate appearances, Corey Seager has hit five long balls (18th in MLB), tallied 12 RBIs and scored 14 runs. He is batting .221/.337/.485 and has posted a 24.1% strikeout rate and a 14.5% walk rate. Seager has recorded one steal on one attempt.
